notes: Maintenance release: CR audit FX-small (#986). Rules behavior change: when the Runner approaches a server, the run stops at the approach-server step whenever any unrezzed ice is installed, decided from open information, so the Runner can no longer tell a facedown ice is Formicary (CR 10.2.2b, 10.2.3a; 6.9.4g). The checkpoint outside the movement phase now also occurs through that stop (CR 10.3.6). The basic trash ability is refused for a card accessed in Archives, in the legal-move list and in apply, through one shared check (basicTrashRefusal; CR 7.1.5b); an upgrade in the root of Archives can still be trashed. Neutralize All Threats' first access of the turn is used up by a card it cannot force (CR 7.1.5d). Pins cards v1.147.25.
